item.title: Hog 0.18.0
item.description:
Native SwiftUI Hog for macOS 26+. Universal (Apple silicon + Intel). Signed with Developer ID and notarized.

What's new

  • Home is the one place to get things done. It lists only what's waiting on you, in four plain sections: Waiting for your review, Asked of you, Ready to merge and Needs a fix. Anything waiting on someone else stays out of the way.
  • Calm rows, one clear action. Each row is one line: the title and one short fact ("anna", "Mentioned", "Approved"). Select one and the detail says why it's there ("Here because your review was requested 2 hours ago, and checks passed"), what's up next, and shows its one action as the highlighted toolbar button: Merge…, Reply, Re-run, Approve… or Done.
  • Keyboard first. Return does the selected row's action, Space moves on, Delete marks it done. When a row leaves, the next one is selected.
  • Hog tidies up for you. Notifications about merged or closed pull requests, and review requests you've already answered, clear themselves. Merge All… merges every ready pull request after one confirmation; green bot updates and failing workflows come as one row each.
  • No more Inbox tab. The sidebar is Home and your repositories. Old Inbox links open Home, and everything else that's unread sits folded under Other updates.

Install: open the DMG and drag Hog to Applications. Installed copies can update through Hog → Check for Updates….

Source: 4d92c716.

item.title: Hog 0.17.0
item.description:

What's new

  • Your app's icon, suggested: in an app's repository, Choose Icon now opens on a Suggested section with the app's own icon, ready for Return. Hog finds Icon Composer icons (AppIcon.icon, drawn from their layers), asset catalog icon sets and .icns files. If you pick an Icon Composer icon, the sidebar updates whenever its layers change.
  • Repository icons in lists: Inbox rows, Home's lists and Home's cards show the repository's icon before its name, so you can see at a glance which repository a row belongs to.
  • Drag repositories into groups: drag a repository between the rows of any group, back to Repositories, or onto a group's header to add it to the end, even when the group is empty or folded.
  • Inbox reads faster: a selected row is marked read after 300 ms instead of 1.5 s. Rows you arrow past stay unread, and the unread dot fades out.

item.title: Hog 0.16.1
item.description:
Native SwiftUI Hog for macOS 26+. Universal (Apple silicon + Intel). Signed with Developer ID and notarized.

What's new

  • CI notifications go somewhere. A branch's workflow runs are one Inbox row that names the branch's pull request ("skills #45 · CI failed at startup · 3 runs"). Selecting it opens the pull request on Checks, or the failed job's log when the branch has no pull request. Read, Unread and Done act on every run in the row, and the Delete key marks rows done, as in Mail.
  • Items open in about 50 ms. A cached pull request or issue paints with its first frame instead of after an empty page and a toolbar rebuild. One that isn't cached shows its title, state and author at once and fills in the body when it arrives.
  • Every gh account at once (0.16.0): pull requests, issues, the inbox and Home from all your signed-in accounts, with an account filter in the sidebar. Requests go out as the account that owns each repository.
  • The list toolbar fits with the sidebar hidden (0.15.3): tabs fold into one menu when room runs out.
  • Opening a pull request no longer blinks (0.13.10): long descriptions are parsed before the page paints, and a spinner waits 300 ms before it shows.

Install: open the DMG and drag Hog to Applications. Installed copies can update through Hog → Check for Updates….

item.title: Hog 0.13.0
item.description:
Native SwiftUI Hog, macOS 26+. Universal (Apple silicon + Intel). Signed with Developer ID and notarized.

What's new

  • A sidebar of places. Home, Inbox, and one row per repository. A repository's Pull Requests, Issues, Code and Actions are now tabs in the list's toolbar (⌥⌘3 to ⌥⌘6), with unread counts. Repositories show their web favicon when they have one, else the owner's avatar, in the sidebar, the overview and Open Quickly (#686)
  • Tabs and title share the toolbar on scroll. Once a pull request's header scrolls away, the tabs turn into round icons and the title joins them in one capsule. Click the title to jump back to the top (#684)
  • "Merging is blocked", and why. A blocked pull request's merge card says what's holding it (a review, failing or running checks, conflicts, an out-of-date branch, no write access) instead of a disabled button with the reason in a tooltip. Merge… is enabled only when it can do something (#683)
  • Two columns on a wide pane. Home's overview puts Up next and the catch-up cards on the left and your activity on the right (#681)
  • A repository's overview catches you up too. Up next, Asked of you, Your work and Merged this week for that repository alone, beside its languages and About when there's room (#682)

Install: open the DMG, drag Hog to Applications. Sign-in reuses gh auth login. Installed copies update themselves.

item.title: Hog 0.12.0
item.description:
Native SwiftUI Hog, macOS 26+. Universal (Apple silicon + Intel). Signed with Developer ID and notarized.

What's new

  • Reading width is yours to set. Settings ▸ General ▸ Reading width: Narrow, Standard, Wide or Full, for how wide a pull request, issue or discussion is laid out (#676)
  • The scrolled title sits at the pane's edge. The pill that appears once the header scrolls away now sits at the leading edge, beside the column, instead of over the text (#676)
  • Reviewers by name. A pull request's reviewers get a line of their own under the state line: avatar, name, and what they said, in color. They were two small avatars at the far end of the line (#677)

What's fixed

  • Files navigator no longer trips AppKit's reentrancy warning. The tree is flat rows with our own chevron; it looks and works the same (#674)

Install: open the DMG, drag Hog to Applications. Sign-in reuses gh auth login.
